name: Boku Iro Ni Somaru Oba
source:
The protagonist Shinozaki Keisuke, visits his grandparents' house alone during summer vacation, and is greeted by his aunt Yuka. Beautiful, kind, and smart, a woman whom he admires since when he was young. However, after learning that his aunt is engaged, he becomes shocked.

Featuring two scenarios, the relationship between the nephew and aunt is depicted differently, depending on the story.

Unwilling to give his beloved aunt to anyone, he tells her his feelings, a story of "Longing and Immorality."

He congratulates her at the time, but several years later, he decides to snatch her away, a story of "Regret and Lust."

A pure-hearted boy or one who grows up to be a man. In each story, a woman in  bewilderment, his aunt is being toyed with. An intimate relationship with her, please enjoy!

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/bokuoba/#outline]official website[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，男主角篠崎圭祐独自前往祖父母家探亲，迎接他的是叔母优花——这位美丽、温柔又聪慧的女性，是他自幼便深深仰慕的对象。然而，在得知叔母已经订婚的消息后，他大受打击。

本作收录了两条不同的剧情路线，从截然不同的角度描绘外甥与叔母之间的关系：

不愿将深爱的叔母拱手让人、毅然向她倾诉心意的“憧憬与背德”篇；

当年强颜欢笑送上祝福，数年后却决意将她夺回身边的“悔恨与情欲”篇。

是纯情直率的少年，还是蜕变成熟的男人——在每一篇故事中，面对外甥的步步紧逼，不知所措的叔母都将在迷乱中任其摆布。敬请享受与她水乳交融的亲密时光！

[译自[url=http://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/bokuoba/#outline]官方网站[/url]（经编辑）]
